summary: Default user-facing semantic pipelines to LLM-first

delivery.outcome: CLI, MCP and A2A invoke audited task-synthesis LLM and workspace-documentation enrichment by default while retaining explicit offline controls and visible fallback evidence
nonGoals: No programmatic service or PipelineOptions default change
No model, prompt, schema or provider change
No dependency, provider, prompt or response-schema change

architecture.decision: Resolve omitted user-facing task mode to require-llm except for the complete explicit offline profile, enable workspace-comparison documentation enrichment by default, and normalize MCP/A2A inputs before the unchanged service boundary
interfaceChanges: compare-workspace accepts --no-docs-llm and defaults documentation enrichment on; --docs-llm remains a compatibility alias
MCP and A2A pipeline requests default omitted taskMode to require-llm outside the complete offline profile
MCP and A2A compare_workspace requests default omitted includeDocsLlm to true
architecture.rollback: Restore omitted task mode to disabled and compare-workspace documentation LLM to opt-in, then remove the focused regressions; explicit modes remain available

validation.evidence: Omitted task mode fails at required LLM task synthesis without a provider
Explicit disabled mode keeps the watch fixture offline
Workspace comparison manifests prove default LLM request and explicit deterministic opt-out
Shared boundary defaults and MCP fail-closed task synthesis pass alongside A2A behavior
Full host, governance and Docker checks pass
